callerKind.description: Who invoked the tool: owner (the control socket's single owner connection) or broker (a broker-authenticated run).

surface.description: Model-facing surface: mcp | channeltools | sidecar | pi-host | pi-child | opencode | mcp-ts.

targetLive.description: A turn is in flight on the resolved target.

targetResumable.description: The resolved target can be continued: a done, failed or blocked sentinel, or a live session id.

targetMatch.description: Resolution outcome for the addressed target: unique | ambiguous | none.

controlReplySupported.description: Retained in the contract; no surface can deliver a control reply now that the claude-channel sidecar is retired.

action.description: One of tell, ask, reply, resume, withdraw, control_reply. Peers actions are deliberately absent: they have no route preconditions and are validated against PeersApplicabilityTable.

target.description: Addressed recipient, run reference or opaque control message id.

rules.reason: not a known action (tell, ask, reply, resume, withdraw, control_reply)
action "control_reply" is retained in the contract but no surface can deliver one
a broker-authenticated run may resume only a run it spawned, which a child cannot own
target is not live for this action
